messages:
maya: Quick thread  Optimize toolkit MVP gates for customer pilots (AcmeHealth). Need a checklist we can show Sales + Eng.

sam: Two rollout lanes: Enterprise (Dedicated) = full cache + quant + eval-alerts; Hosted = batching + ephemeral cache, quant opt-in.

anya: We must include a customer opt-in form and pilot SLA (canary % traffic, rollback windows). Sales needs the wording.

jordan: Concordance gating idea: run per-customer prompt set, require >=80% semantic concordance for 3 runs before quant enablement. If fails, auto-fallback to FP32 variant.

liam: Eviction policy callout: prefer LRU for interactive prefix cache initially. Prefetch TTL maybe 50 min for typical chat flows.

maya: Acceptance checklist (short):
- SDK telemetry + model_variant tag instrumented
- Batching p95 delta >=15% on benchmark mix
- Cache hit-rate >=20% in smoke window
- Quant concordance >=80% on pilot prompts (3 runs)
- Eval-alert wiring + Ops runbook for rollback

anya: For alerting, reduce noise: require-trigger = 2 consecutive windows and include FP suppression for rare prompts.

jordan: Example alert rule:
```
name: quant_concordance_drop
window: 12h
threshold: 0.80
consecutive: 2
action: switch-variant, notify-ops, open-ticket
```

sam: Who owns telemetry schema? I can lead if Runtime allocates one FTE. ETA 3w. Need token-level timings + variant tag.

maya: Good. Sam + Jordan to finalize schema and canary plan. Anya will draft the customer opt-in copy. Liam to size cache TTL & eviction tuning. If no objections by Fri EOD, lock sprint scope. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: CI /optimize/toolkit/telemetry checks passed on branch feature/optimize-telemetry.
